ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  5paisa Capital Limited reported the resignation of Independent Director Ms. Nirali Sanghi, effective November 25, 2026, citing increased professional commitments. This creates a vacancy on the Board and its committees, potentially impacting corporate governance continuity until a replacement is appointed. Crucially, both the company and Ms. Sanghi explicitly confirm no other material reasons for her departure, thereby mitigating immediate red flags.
